MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The solder seal connectors felt useful because my earlier spade connector purchase gives me a concrete reason to consider other ways to repair and seal wiring.",
    "Heat shrink tubing would complement my existing electrical connectors by insulating repaired wires, so either assortment felt like a natural addition."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Washers, screws, and battery lugs require particular sizes and applications; my past repair purchases do not establish a need for those exact parts.",
    "Buying a handtruck does not mean I need separate caster wheels, and buying hose clamps does not establish a need for O-ring lubricant.",
    "My adhesive purchases do not mean I currently need epoxy or ten tubes of super glue; the repair purpose and quantity matter."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as a broad interest in repair supplies, when I usually choose supplies for a specific job.",
    "My smaller-wire spade connectors were taken as a reason to suggest heavy battery cable lugs, even though the wire size and connection purpose differ."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about how a new supply would work with something I already own, which is why insulation for my connectors feels more useful than unrelated hardware.",
    "The two heat shrink assortments meet essentially the same need for me; after choosing one, I would have little reason to choose the other.",
    "My latest clamp purchase specifies a five-inch size, so other maintenance supplies need a clearer connection to that task to interest me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my practical repair interests, but only the wiring supplies offered a clear connection to equipment I already own."
}
